answer: Bind each identity to a physical chip. At registration and every epoch, an agent sends a TPM quote signed by its chip's factory-burned endorsement key, measuring the boot chain up to the kernel. The ledger allows one identity per endorsement key. A virtual TPM can mirror the quote format but not a vendor-signed key, so a farm can't spin up an ocean of VMs; each fake needs its own device, maybe $150 used (illustrative). Rented attested cloud chips are the gap, so rewards vest only to keys seen for 10+ epochs.
